maria: quick thought  we should add a tiny "progress" signal + priority hint at the gateway so clients can degrade gracefully instead of hard timing out.
akshay: ok. what's the wire surface? header vs event stream?
maria: header opt-in + sparse progress events for streaming. headers: `Priority-Hint: low|normal|high`, `X-Redwood-Progress: enable=true`. events: stage tokens like queued, started, first-token, partial, final.
dom: two caveats: (1) cached prefixes may make progress misleading, (2) tie progress to admission/backpressure so low-priority gets coarser updates.
olivia: metrics note 0: add span tags `progress.stage` and `progress.last_ts`. sample events should be low-cardinality (coarse partial buckets).
maria: sample progress payload (opt-in only): `{ progress_id: "p-abc", stage: "partial", bucket: "50%", variant: "small-fallback", attempt: 1 }`
akshay: retries should increment attempt in progress_id (p-abc-2). SDKs map Priority-Hint -> UI/backoff.
dom: define admission: score = base - penalty(priority) - age_penalty; reserve soft-share % for high priority to avoid preempting in-flight.
maria: ops plan: feature-flag `progress-v1` on gateway, emit sparse events every ~2s or on stage change, SDK opt-in and README, metrics + alert `p95 time to first progress > 2s` for high routes.
ci-bot: deploy queued for feature/progress-v1 to staging at 1743322045 1: tests passed.
maria: owner: @akshay proto headers + emission. @olivia metrics. @dom eviction numbers. i'll write RFC follow-up with enum values and compatibility notes. :thumbsup:
